text:
Priya Nair: Heads-up: planned migration for user_profiles schema at 23:00 UTC in the midnight change window. This includes a small backfill (approx 12m) and an index addition. Requesting quick ops + canary signoff.

Tom Chen: noted. can we pin the service version to v2.14.3 for the window? last rollout showed index-related races on v2.15.

Eva López: +1 pin to v2.14.3. I'll watch the canary and keep rollback criteria ready.

Priya Nair: Thanks. Rollback criteria proposal: 1) 95p latency increase >200ms for 5min, 2) error rate >1% for 3min, 3) deploybot reports stuck db locks >60s on >5% of shards. If any hit, abort and rollback to pre-migration snapshot. Thoughts?

Jamal Rivera: Criteria look good. Add: if replica lag >30s for >2min, we pause backfill and evaluate. Backfill pace should be capped at 250 r/s.

Tom Chen: +1 to Jamal. Also add a graceful-open fallback: if canary fails, automatic fallback to read-only mode for client traffic for 10m while we roll forward/rollback.

deploy-bot: Scheduled migration job created: migrator/job/2026-03-23-1865432109. Canary: 2 nodes, target sample=1%. Commands: `deploybot start migrator/job/2026-03-23-1865432109 --canary`

Priya Nair: Release notes snippet (for public changelog): "Schema change: user_profiles -> add indexed last_active_at for faster recency queries. No breaking API changes. Minor backfill expected; ops will monitor latency and replication health." Keep brief.

Eva López: For internal release notes add: steps to rollback, snapshot id: snap-2026-03-22-08, rollback script path: infra/db/rollback/user_profiles_20260323.sql.

oncall-bot: Alert policy set: PT-DB-LOCKS to @oncall and @eng-sre. Pager if lock_count > 10 for 5m.

Jamal Rivera: I'll prepare the rollback checklist and handover doc in the deploy runbook: docs/runbooks/migrations/user_profiles_march23.md. Will link when ready.

Tom Chen: Final ask: can we make the deploybot holdpoint at canary+10m for manual confirm? Please set `--holdpoint canary:10m` so we don't auto-roll.

deploy-bot: Updated job migrator/job/2026-03-23-1865432109 with parameter `--holdpoint canary:10m`. Will not continue without `deploybot resume`.

Priya Nair: Perfect. +1 from product. Lock owners please ensure client-side backoff configured. I'll post the runbook link in 5.

Eva López: Runbook link: https://internal.docs/runbooks/user_profiles_march23.md — includes watchlist, rollback commands, and kafka-sink check steps.

Tom Chen: Acknowledged. I'll be on-call and ready to trigger `deploybot resume` once canary looks healthy.

Priya Nair: Closing: pinned version v2.14.3, canary holdpoint +10m, rollback criteria agreed, alerting hooked. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
